Sara Torres
sara.torres@example.com | Baltimore, MD
Sara Torres has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Cobalt Technologies (2023-2026), where they
applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 54K concurrent
users. Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Foundry Data (2017-2023).
Education: B.S. Computer Engineering, NC State University, 2016. Core skills:
PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Node.js, Docker.
